title: Separate Circle platform share, Coinbase eligible-product average balances and Coinbase AOP custody balances
decisions: Supersede the mislabeled MOBS-CIRCLE-Q2-USDC-RESERVE-PLATFORM-20261030 with a corrected Circle-specific observation; preserve the prior graph and snapshot immutably.

Record Circle Q2 USDC-on-platform as USD12.442B end balance and 19.5% daily weighted-average share of circulation on Circle's own platform, including Circle Mint, corporate-held USDC and Circle-provided non-custodial wallets.

Record Coinbase Q3 average USD22B USDC held in eligible Coinbase products as a separate company-defined metric; the earnings deck says it was approximately 30% of average USDC market capitalization and up 49% year over year.

Record Coinbase Q3 AOP USDC USD8.616B at September 30 as a separate point-in-time custody/digital-wallet measure. Do not reconcile it directly to the USD22B average eligible-product metric without aligning definitions and time bases.

Record Circle Q2 USD655.3M H1 and USD324.6M Q2 distribution costs under Coinbase agreements. Do not infer Coinbase's numeric share of Circle's average USDC on-platform balances from Circle's 19.5% Circle-platform metric.
Retain Coinbase Q3 stablecoin revenue USD306.905M, down approximately 5.4% YoY, with higher balances contributing USD84.6M and lower rates reducing revenue USD52.8M.
Keep Circle/SBI JV and SBI equity investment as confirmed direct Circle-SBI relationships; do not infer Circle-Ripple partnership or XRP demand.
Do not admit these company metrics as XRP prediction features until synchronized, independently sourced, causally mapped and shown to add out-of-sample value.
rationale: Circle Q2 2026 10-Q lines 1578-1580 explicitly define Circle's own USDC-on-platform measure and its reserve-income use.
Coinbase Q3 2026 earnings deck defines average USDC held in Coinbase products as corporate balances plus customer balances in eligible Coinbase products.
Coinbase Q3 2026 10-Q separately defines Assets on Platform and reports USD8.616B USDC at September 30.

Circle Q2 2026 10-Q separately reports distribution costs under Coinbase agreements and states Coinbase's share of average USDC on-platform balances decreased, without assigning it the 19.5% Circle metric.
next_action: On Circle's November 4 Q3 results, extract the same Circle-defined USDC-on-platform, reserve-return, Coinbase distribution-cost and Circle SBI JV metrics. Reconcile Coinbase Q3 eligible-product averages and AOP only after matching definitions and time bases.
